root_causes: Optimistic UI flips state without waiting for HTTP 200
API trusts Redis cached value and does not re-check DB when cached=false
Redis keys lacked tenant scoping, causing cross-tenant leaks
Cache invalidation was asynchronous and lacked distributed locking
fixes_applied: Added tenant_id column to model and Redis keys now include tenant prefix
FollowService.get_following reconciles Redis with DB on cache miss and when cached=false
FollowService uses distributed lock abstraction for atomic follow/unfollow writes
FollowService publishes on Redis pub/sub when relationships change
Frontend FollowButton removed unconditional optimistic update and shows loading/rollback on failure
Added composite unique constraint to followers table and excluded soft-deleted rows from active queries
